oracle.name: Power Pages Liquid renderer
oracle.scope: Two native Power Pages renders per run of 82 unchanged original Liquid programs, each included as a source template by an isolated request, on 2026-11-08; the two runs agree. Establishes rendered text for these programs only. The native site modes are not published in the evidence, so input.observed is the simulator configuration authored for this suite; the native outcome labels (rendered or parser rejection) are not replayed, only the text.
